title: Juicy Flaky Chinese Pork Dim Sum
description: A traditional Chinese dim sum dish featuring pork and granulated sugar, baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven, with a mediterranean twist, served in a mason jar.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped pork, granulated sugar, soy sauce, sesame oil, and grated ginger, and mix well.
Lay a wonton wrapper on a flat surface and place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with a small amount of water and fold the wrapper into a triangle, pressing the edges together to seal the dim sum.
Repeat the process with the remaining wrappers and pork mixture.
Place the dim sum in the mason jars, leaving about 1 inch of space at the top.
Cover the jars with a lid and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the jars from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the dim sum hot, garnished with chopped green onions.
